opportunities.name: NPS: find a park by state and open its info page
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use the 'Find a Park – By State' dropdown to pick {state}, then open the {info_section} link (Basic Information / Current Conditions / Heritage Area) for {park} on the state page.
steps: Click the 'By State...' dropdown under FIND A PARK
On the state parks page, scroll to {park}
Click the {info_section} link for that park (e.g. Basic Information, Current Conditions, National Heritage Area)

instances.values: state=Alaska; National Heritage Areas -> Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm NHA

opportunities.name: Resy: book tickets for a special event in a city
opportunities.description: On resy.com, switch to {city}, open Special Events & Experiences, choose {event}, set the {ticket_count}, pick a ticket tier or time and continue to Complete Your Reservation.
steps: Pick {city} in the city dropdown (or use the city's home page)
Open Special Events & Experiences (search box > collections/'View all', or 'See More')
Click Book Now or a time slot for {ticket_tier_or_time}
Review the Complete Your Reservation dialog and click Reserve Now

instances.values: city=Miami; event=Carbone Beach 2023 Thu May 4; 3 tickets; Centurion Member Access tier ($9,810 total)
city=Atlanta; event=Aria Happy Hour Burger Apr 13; 1 ticket; 5:00 PM

opportunities.name: Megabus: track a bus by service number
opportunities.description: On megabus.com, open Check my bus, switch to the Service Number tab, enter {service_number}, choose the matching route and click Find my bus.
steps: On the megabus home page, click 'Check my bus' in the top nav
Pick the bus tracker option in the dropdown
Pick the suggested route from the list
